characters.name: Aden
characters.direction: bright, curious, playful, hopeful lead energy; tiny natural child voice, not squeaky
characters.en_text: Hello! Would you like to play with me today? I found something wonderful!
characters.tr_text: Merhaba! Bugün benimle oyun oynamak ister misin? Çok güzel bir şey buldum!

characters.name: Kaan
characters.direction: soft cheerful toddler, spontaneous little laughs, very short early words and reactions

characters.name: Esra
characters.direction: warm reassuring mother, calm, affectionate, clear and patient
characters.en_text: Come here, children. We can solve this together, calmly and with a smile.
characters.tr_text: Gelin çocuklar. Bunu birlikte, sakin ve gülümseyerek çözebiliriz.

characters.name: Ahmet
characters.direction: kind relaxed father, grounded, supportive and naturally warm
characters.en_text: That sounds like a good plan. Let's help each other and enjoy the day.
characters.tr_text: Bu güzel bir plan gibi görünüyor. Birbirimize yardım edip günün tadını çıkaralım.

characters.name: Esma
characters.direction: friendly warm aunt, lively but gentle, expressive without exaggeration
characters.en_text: I have a fun idea. We can make it together and everyone can join us.
characters.tr_text: Eğlenceli bir fikrim var. Bunu birlikte yapabiliriz, herkes bize katılabilir.

characters.name: Harun
characters.direction: warm confident optimistic anchor figure, calm humor, reassuring and energetic when needed
characters.en_text: No problem, we can handle it together. First we make a plan, then we get moving.
characters.tr_text: Sorun yok, bunu birlikte hallederiz. Önce bir plan yaparız, sonra harekete geçeriz.

characters.name: Veysel
characters.direction: friendly sociable adult, upbeat natural rhythm, distinct from Harun and Ahmet
characters.en_text: Great idea! I can help too. Let's make this a fun day for everyone.
characters.tr_text: Harika fikir! Ben de yardım edebilirim. Bugünü herkes için eğlenceli yapalım.

characters.name: Öznur
characters.direction: warm composed adult woman, friendly and clear, gentle conversational energy
characters.en_text: Let's take our time and do it carefully. Everyone can have a turn.
characters.tr_text: Acele etmeden dikkatlice yapalım. Herkes sırayla deneyebilir.

characters.name: Salih
characters.direction: playful two-year-old, short phrases, curious reactions, believable toddler rhythm
characters.en_text: Look! Big ball! My turn? Let's play!
characters.tr_text: Bak! Büyük top! Sıra bende mi? Oynayalım!

characters.name: Medine
characters.direction: very young infant coos, tiny laughs, soft fussing and crying only; no sentence speech

characters.name: Davut
characters.direction: good-humored relaxed adult man, warm, distinct, natural comic timing when appropriate
characters.en_text: Well, that made me laugh. Come on, I have an idea that might actually work.
characters.tr_text: Bu beni güldürdü. Hadi, işe yarayabilecek bir fikrim var.

characters.name: Fatoş
characters.direction: friendly expressive adult woman, warm family tone, natural and not theatrical
characters.en_text: Everyone is ready. Let's start together and make sure the children are having fun.
characters.tr_text: Herkes hazır. Birlikte başlayalım ve çocukların eğlendiğinden emin olalım.

characters.name: Emoş
characters.direction: energetic four-year-old girl, confident playful preschool rhythm, clearly distinct from Aden
characters.en_text: I know what we can do! Come on, follow me! This is going to be fun!
characters.tr_text: Ne yapacağımızı biliyorum! Hadi, beni takip edin! Çok eğlenceli olacak!

characters.name: Berzan
characters.direction: two-year-old twin, brighter and more impulsive toddler voice, short phrases
characters.en_text: Me first! Look! Fast! Again, again!
characters.tr_text: Önce ben! Bak! Hızlı! Bir daha, bir daha!

characters.name: Aras
characters.direction: two-year-old twin, softer and calmer toddler voice, short phrases; distinct from Berzan
characters.en_text: Wait for me. Look, I found it. Can we play?
characters.tr_text: Beni bekle. Bak, buldum. Oynayabilir miyiz?

characters.name: Ramin
characters.direction: newborn coos, breaths, tiny fussing and crying only; no sentence speech
